options.text: A type of chromosome found in sex cells
A complete molecule of DNA
A protein that controls cell division
A section of DNA that codes for a specific protein

questions.explanation: A gene is a section (length) of DNA that codes for a specific protein. The sequence of bases in a gene determines the sequence of amino acids in the protein, which determines the protein's structure and function.

questions.stem: How many pairs of chromosomes do human body cells contain?

options.text: 23 pairs
46 pairs
22 pairs
12 pairs

questions.explanation: Human body cells contain 23 pairs of chromosomes (46 in total). 22 pairs are autosomes (non-sex chromosomes) and 1 pair are sex chromosomes (XX in females, XY in males).

options.text: A type of chromosome
A pair of genes on the same chromosome
A different form (version) of a gene
A section of RNA

questions.explanation: An allele is a different form or version of a gene. For example, the gene for eye colour may have a blue allele or a brown allele. Each person inherits two alleles for each gene, one from each parent.

questions.stem: What is the relationship between DNA, genes, and chromosomes?

options.text: DNA is made of chromosomes, which contain genes
Chromosomes are made of genes, which are made of DNA
Genes are made of chromosomes, which are made of DNA
Chromosomes contain DNA, which is organised into genes

questions.explanation: Chromosomes are long molecules of DNA. Sections of this DNA that code for specific proteins are called genes. So chromosomes contain DNA, and genes are specific sections within that DNA.

questions.stem: What does it mean if a cell is 'diploid'?

options.text: It contains two sets of chromosomes (pairs)
It contains no chromosomes
It contains four sets of chromosomes
It contains one set of chromosomes

questions.explanation: A diploid cell contains two complete sets of chromosomes, one inherited from each parent. Human body cells are diploid with 46 chromosomes (23 pairs). Gametes are haploid with only 23 chromosomes (one set).

options.text: The number of chromosomes in a gamete
The sex chromosomes only
A single gene that determines a person's appearance
The entire set of genetic material (DNA) in an organism

questions.explanation: The human genome is the entire set of genetic material (all the DNA) in a human being. The Human Genome Project mapped all approximately 20,000-25,000 genes in the human genome.

questions.stem: Where on a chromosome are genes located?

options.text: Only at the ends of chromosomes
At specific positions called loci along the chromosome
Only in the centre of chromosomes
Floating freely inside the nucleus

questions.explanation: Each gene occupies a specific fixed position on a chromosome called its locus (plural: loci). Homologous chromosomes have the same genes at the same loci, though they may carry different alleles.
